caption:
You think your team answers fast.

Prove it this week.

Step 1: Pick three lead channels you advertise on. Google, Facebook, your website form.

Step 2: Have someone else, not you, submit a real inquiry on each one today. A friend, a spouse, an employee.

Step 3: They log the exact time they hit submit. You log the time a human actually replies.

Industry research shows most service businesses take over an hour to respond, and only about 17% reply within 60 minutes.

Respond within 5 minutes and you roughly double your odds of closing that lead.

Run the test. Then fix the gap with a free tool that tracks it.

DM TOOLS

rationale: Quick-tutorial to-camera reels win completion and saves right now, and this ships a genuinely unclaimed self-diagnostic test (third-party mystery-shop, not the owner calling themselves) distinct from every prior script, framework, and audit angle already shipped.
